Jeffrey Epstein's links to the world of science are examined in this Joe Rogan Experience segment. Epstein, a wealthy financier and convicted sex offender, funded researchers and courted famous labs and universities. His money bought him access to some of the brightest names in science.

Rogan and his guest go through which institutions took his donations and what they gave in return. They ask why so many smart people stayed close to a man with a known record. The talk mixes money, power, and moral failure in equal parts. Listeners disturbed by the case get a focused look at one of its least examined corners.
